subject: Request: interim assurance endorsement for SOC 2 Type II period (post-report gap)
messages:
From: Emma Hayes <emma.hayes@protelix.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Protelix Legal <legal@protelix.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2027 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: Interim assurance request for post-report period (SOC 2 Type II)

Hi Vanessa,

Hope you’re well — we’re finalizing our vendor risk review for the coming board packet and we noticed Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report ends 2027-06-30. Our compliance team requires an interim assurance or statement that covers the period between the report end date and our contract start (we’re onboarding in Jan). Can you provide a short endorsement/bridge statement or confirm the controls and monitoring status since 2027-07-01 to present?

Items our SOC team typically needs:
- A one-page affirmation or bridge letter referencing 2027-06-30 report and extending coverage to a recent date
- Any major control changes or exceptions since the report period
- Evidence summary (what controls were run and when) and a contact for audit follow-ups

If useful, I’ve attached our vendor checklist template — happy to accept a draft and share with legal. Ideally can we have something by Dec 6 to make the board packet deadline?

Thanks,
Emma
Emma Hayes
Sr. Vendor Risk Manager | Protelix Therapeutics

Hi Emma — thanks for the clear ask and the deadline. We can do a short interim assurance letter (often called an affirmation or bridge note) that references our SOC 2 Type II report (period ending 2027-06-30) and summarizes controls posture through a specified date.

Plan: 
- I’ll draft a brief affirmation that calls out no material exceptions since 2027-07-01 and references our monitoring artifacts.
- Neha will pull the controls monitoring snapshots (alert triage, change control logs) and a short evidence summary.
- Karthik will review the legal phrasing for any contract language flags.

Can you confirm the exact date you need us to cover through? We can state coverage "through 2027-11-30" (end of last month) or a rolling "through the date of the letter" — many customers prefer an explicit cutoff that matches your packet.

We’ll attach the SOC2 report excerpt and a 1-page controls summary. I’ll share a draft by Wed (Dec 1) for your legal review, and we can iterate.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Trust & Compliance | Redwood Inference
